project.name: Music Wizard :: Integration Tests
project.description:
Tests that span modules. Mostly the slow, externally-dependent ones -- model downloads, LilyPond invocation, the MIDI to audio to Score ground-truth loop -- which are named *IT and only run under -Pintegration.
Four are named *Test, so surefire runs them in the default build. MidiRoundTripTest exports a Score through mw-notation and reads it back through mw-transcribe, and StaffNotationOverloadTest reads what the emitter writes for a played passage; both need audio, model and binary alike not at all, and both are here because neither module may depend on the other -- mw-transcribe pulls in mw-ml, which the notation layer is not allowed to see -- and this is the module that already depends on both. LilyPondComplaintsTest reads LilyPond's diagnostics without running it, and explains there why it belongs here.
The rule, from #148 and #155: a test that needs no LilyPond is named *Test, whatever else is in the file it was written in. What that buys is which job runs it -- every `mvn verify` and every CI job, rather than only the one where someone remembered -Pintegration, which is the job #145 showed can stay red and unread for weeks. It does not buy noticing a test that stops running: failIfNoTests is not configured here, so a *Test that disappears is as silent as an *IT that does.
The fourth, GmajorBluesChartTest, is the one that needed this paragraph rewritten rather than the one that fitted it (#200). It decodes an 11 MB mp3 the repository carries and tracks its beats: no LilyPond, no model and no network, but neither fast nor binary-free. It costs about five seconds, and it needs more heap than the default build had ever asked for -- which is why surefire below pins one rather than leaving it to the JVM's 1/4-of-RAM default. Measured: it fails at 320 MB and passes at 384 MB, where every other test in this module passes at 256 MB. A container capped low enough would otherwise fail `mvn verify` with a dead fork and no test report naming the cause, on machines nobody develops on. It is here anyway, and named so that every job runs it, because it is the project's only tier-2 gate -- CLAUDE.md ranks real recordings above synthetic fixtures, and #200 is a defect that eleven minutes of real timing showed immediately and every synthetic fixture in the repository was blind to.
So the rule as amended: a test that needs no LilyPond, no model download and no network is named *Test. `mvn verify` stays offline. It is no longer binary-free, and the price of that is stated above rather than discovered.
